name: @keel-engine/architecture
description: The built city on a city's lots and streets: zoning envelopes, massing (podium and tower, wedding-cake setbacks, L and U wings, crowns), metric facade grids, rooftop kit, neon and LED signs; parks, plazas and public art; street lamps, furniture, traffic lights and signposts along every road -- plans a lot, worlds a block, painted through a district's looks. Pure functions of (city seed, lot key / road id); the catalogues are data a pack provides. Deterministic dmath, no GL, no packs.
